name: What accessibility modifications can be added to a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility modifications can be added to a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility modifications can include zero-barrier curbless showers, wider entryways, slip-resistant tile, comfort-height toilets, and reinforced blocking behind walls for grab bars. The right approach depends on whether you are planning for future aging in place or solving immediate mobility needs. Curbless showers require recessed subflooring and meticulous waterproofing, so planning these structural adjustments before demo begins ensures smooth execution and safe long-term use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include curbless showers, grab bar wall blocking, comfort-height toilets, wider doors, and non-slip tile to improve safety and mobility.
